gfr-calculator.assumptionNote: Uses the CKD-EPI 2021 equation without a race factor, for adults 18+. A single creatinine value cannot diagnose kidney disease; doctors confirm with repeat tests, urine tests and clinical context.
benefits: Translates a lab creatinine number into the kidney-function estimate doctors actually use.
Shows your CKD stage instantly with plain-language context.
Helps you prepare informed questions before a doctor visit.
Private: sensitive health numbers never leave your browser.

faqs.a: GFR estimates how many millilitres of blood your kidneys filter per minute, standardised to a 1.73 m2 body surface. Higher is better; above 90 is normal.
Because muscle mass, diet, hydration and medicines all shift creatinine, and GFR formulas carry their own error. A result under 60 should be rechecked after 3 months before any CKD label is used.
faqs.q: Why do doctors repeat the test?

faqs.a: In 2021 the race multiplier was removed because race is a social construct, not a biological variable. The refit equation works for everyone without it.
faqs.q: Why was the race factor removed?

faqs.a: Roughly 0.6 to 1.2 mg/dL for men and 0.5 to 1.1 mg/dL for women, but ranges vary by lab, muscle mass and age. Always use your lab's reference range.
Stay hydrated, control blood pressure and blood sugar, avoid NSAID overuse, do not smoke, and get kidney checks if you have diabetes or hypertension. These protect GFR over decades.
faqs.q: How can I protect my kidney function?

faqs.a: eGFR is an estimate with real error, especially above 60 where it is capped in meaning. Cystatin C or a measured GFR gives a truer number when precision matters.

gfr-calculator.formula:
CKD-EPI 2021 (no race factor):
eGFR = 142 x min(Scr/k,1)^a x max(Scr/k,1)^-1.2 x 0.9938^age x 1.012 (if female).
k = 0.7 (female) or 0.9 (male); a = -0.241 (F, Scr<=0.7), -0.302 (M, Scr<=0.9), else -1.2.
Stages: G1 >=90, G2 60-89, G3a 45-59, G3b 30-44, G4 15-29, G5 <15.
howTo: Enter your serum creatinine in mg/dL from your lab report.
Read your estimated GFR and CKD stage.
Discuss the result with your doctor; a single value is never a diagnosis.
keyFacts: GFR is the best overall measure of kidney function.
The CKD-EPI 2021 equation removed the race factor used in older versions.
GFR naturally declines with age, about 1 mL/min/1.73m2 per year after 40.
Results are reported per 1.73 m2 of body surface area.
A GFR below 60 for more than 3 months defines chronic kidney disease.
A 50-year-old man with creatinine 1.1 mg/dL has an eGFR of about 82.
